blogs.title: Rotate, Don’t Rewrite: A Gentle Intro to Orthogonal Fine-Tuning for Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Explain the core idea behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT): learning layer-wise rotations that preserve pairwise neuron angles and thus pretrained semantics. Walk through why this maintains image quality, improves stability, and converges faster than naive fine-tuning, with intuitive visuals and small examples.

blogs.title: Hyperspherical Energy 101: Why Angles Preserve Semantics in Deep Nets
blogs.description: Demystify hyperspherical energy, cosine similarity, and the unit hypersphere. Show how preserving pairwise neuron angles correlates with maintaining semantic generation ability in text-to-image models, referencing the toy experiment that separates magnitude from angular information.

blogs.title: COFT in Practice: Safer, More Predictable Fine-Tuning of Stable Diffusion
blogs.description: Offer a practical guide to Constrained Orthogonal Finetuning (COFT), which adds an epsilon constraint on rotations for extra stability. Cover hyperparameter choices (epsilon, block count), recommended layers (attention), training schedules, and how to avoid collapse across subjects and control tasks.

blogs.title: LoRA vs OFT vs ControlNet: Choosing the Right Tool for Personalization and Control
blogs.description: Compare parameter efficiency, convergence speed, controllability, and inference overhead across LoRA, OFT/COFT, ControlNet, and T2I-Adapter. Provide a decision framework: subject-driven generation vs extra control signals, data availability, deployment constraints, and expected quality.

blogs.title: From 5 Photos to a Personalized Generator: A DreamBooth-Style Tutorial with OFT
blogs.description: Step-by-step tutorial to train a subject-driven model using Stable Diffusion v1.5 and OFT. Cover data prep, identity initialization, block-diagonal setup, prompts for validation, and best practices to preserve identity while following text guidance.

blogs.title: Efficient Orthogonal Parameterization: Cayley Transforms and Block-Diagonal Tricks
blogs.description: Dive into the engineering behind OFT’s efficiency: parameterizing rotations via the Cayley transform, using skew-symmetric matrices, and reducing parameters with block-diagonal and shared-block strategies. Discuss complexity trade-offs and implementation tips to keep training fast.

blogs.title: Measuring Control That Matters: Practical Consistency Metrics for Text-to-Image
blogs.description: Introduce simple, reproducible metrics to quantify controllability: IoU/F1 for edges, mean IoU/accuracy for segmentation, and landmark L2 error for faces. Show how to extract control signals from generated images and why these task-specific metrics beat generic FID for control evaluation.

blogs.title: Zero Extra Inference Cost: Deploying OFT-Finetuned Models at Production Scale
blogs.description: Explain how to fold the learned orthogonal matrices into base weights to eliminate runtime overhead. Share deployment checklists, model packaging tips, compatibility with popular UIs, and how to A/B test for quality and latency regressions.

blogs.title: Composable Control: Stacking Orthogonal Updates for Multi-Skill Diffusion
blogs.description: Explore the idea of composing multiple OFT updates by multiplying orthogonal matrices to combine skills (e.g., subject identity plus canny control). Discuss benefits, potential conflicts, and practical strategies for composing and prioritizing controls.

blogs.title: Angles Over Magnitudes: The Fourier Phase Analogy for What Neurons Remember
blogs.description: Use the phase-vs-magnitude analogy from Fourier transforms to explain why directions (angles) carry semantics in neural networks. Provide simple visual demos and connect the intuition to why OFT can modify outputs without erasing pretrained knowledge.

blogs.title: Migrating from LoRA to OFT: A Practitioner’s Checklist
blogs.description: Guide teams already using LoRA on how to try OFT: mapping rank to block counts, selecting layers, tuning learning rates and schedules, and interpreting convergence. Include common pitfalls and how to replicate LoRA-like behavior with COFT’s epsilon constraint.

blogs.title: Beyond Diffusion: Can Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Help Language, Audio, and RL?
blogs.description: Speculate and prototype ideas for applying OFT’s angle-preserving updates to Transformers in NLP, audio synthesis, and policy networks in RL. Highlight where orthogonal updates could boost stability, preserve pretraining knowledge, and lower inference cost.
